title: About City Pass Index | City Pass Index
description: What City Pass Index is, how the independent price data is funded, how corrections work and how to report a wrong pass or attraction price.
text: Home About About Passes, prices, no theatre City Pass Index is an independent data project: checked prices, break-even maths and a calculator that does not ask for your email. Independent Dated data No pay-to-play Why this exists Pass marketing is built to make the maths feel obvious. It usually is not: the value depends entirely on which five attractions you would visit anyway. This site exists to put the gate prices next to the pass price and let the numbers decide. Funding At launch the site is free to read and carries no affiliate links. If that changes, affected pages will disclose it before the link and the ranking will not be for sale. Corrections Prices change. If a figure is wrong, tell us the page, the operator's current price and the date you checked it; we will update the page and the checked date. One pass update a month Price changes and new city coverage, no spam. Email ad

title: City Pass Index Methodology | City Pass Index
description: How City Pass Index collects pass and attraction prices, what the break-even means and how often the data is updated.
text: Home Methodology Methodology How the numbers are built A price without a date and a source is a rumour. Every figure on this site has both. Official sources Dated checks No pay-to-play Gate prices Attraction prices come from the operator's own booking page, not a reseller. We record the lowest adult "from" price on the checked date and note when dynamic pricing means the checkout price can be higher. Pass prices Pass prices and inclusions come from the pass operator's official sales page. The break-even is the pass price divided by the number of attractions it covers; that is the average gate value each visit must beat. What is excluded Transport, food, add-ons (crown access, the 102nd floor, City Climb and similar) and packages. Those belong in the attraction guides, not in the pass comparison.
